name: Heavenly Armillary
desc: An armillary sphere with the power of regeneration. The jewel in the center's healing power is amplified by the sphere itself, boosting its effect tenfold. Touching it heals minor injuries instantly.

eff.name: Celestial Guidance
eff.desc1: Restores target's HP with [Lv. x 30] power and removes 1 negative effect(s).
eff.desc2: Restores target's HP by [Lv. x 100] and acquires an additional [Lv. x 1]% environmental mana.

eff.name: Emancipating Wings
eff.desc1: Removes [Lv. x 1] negative effect(s) from the target and boosts ATK, DEF, and SPD by 10% for each effect removed.
eff.desc2: Boosts target's movement speed by [Lv. x 2]%.

eff.name: Automatic Reboot
eff.desc1: Grants [Lv. x 1] stack(s) of Damage Restoration to the target.
eff.desc2: After using an item, its effect will reactivate every 30 second(s) for [Lv. x 1] time(s).
